from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, sys
folder = Path('products/services/invoice-line-total-pilot')
control = folder / 'fictional-controls.json'
assert control.is_file(), 'Committed fictional controls are required'
script = folder / 'reconcile_subtotal.py'
script.write_text(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8')
old = json.loads(control.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
cases = [(row['case'], 'line_amount\n' + '\n'.join(row['line_amounts']) + '\n', row['declared_subtotal'], 0 if row['verdict'] == 'MATCH' else 1, row['declared_minus_computed']) for row in old['results']]
cases += [('over_limit', 'line_amount\n' + '1.00\n' * 21, '21.00', 2, None), ('invalid_precision', 'line_amount\n1.001\n', '1.00', 2, None), ('exact_cent_control', 'line_amount\n0.10\n0.20\n', '0.30', 0, '0.00')]
results = []
for name, csv, declared, expected_exit, delta in cases:
    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script), declared], input=csv, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    report = json.loads(run.stdout)
    assert run.returncode == expected_exit and report.get('declared_minus_computed') == delta, (name, run.returncode, report)
    results.append({'case': name, 'exit': run.returncode, 'report': report})
receipt = json.dumps({'scope': 'Fictional offline controls against the CLI. One CAD invoice per invocation.', 'results': results}, indent=2) + '\n'
(folder / 'cli-controls.json').write_text(receipt, encoding='utf-8')
print(receipt)
